summary: Scoped to form save only: invalid email gives no feedback while the fixture rejects the draft.

environment.boundary: Form completion only; no other pages authorized.

journeys.task: Save contact draft with invalid email

evidence.caption: Save appears idle; fixture log reports validation rejection.

findings.title: Save gives no feedback when validation rejects the draft
findings.preconditions: Invalid email test@ entered; scoped form review.
findings.expected: Visible error or status when save cannot complete.
findings.observed: No error or status; focus remains on Save; fixture rejects draft.
findings.expectation_basis: Basic form feedback convention and fixture rejection log.
findings.consequence: User may believe the draft saved when it did not.
findings.severity_reason: Core save goal fails without explanation.
findings.confidence_reason: Supplied trace and fixture log align.
findings.frequency_basis: estimated: any invalid format on save

recommendation.change: Show inline validation linked to the email field when save is rejected.
recommendation.tradeoff: Earlier validation may interrupt typing; keep save-attempt feedback at minimum.
recommendation.disconfirming_result: If authorized replay shows visible rejection, this finding would not reproduce.

findings.acceptance_test: Given test@, press Save; an error linked to email appears and no draft is created without silent failure.

strengths: Valid address saves with visible confirmation in the control trace.
limitations: Authored packet only; no executed browser session.
Admin and other pages were out of scope and not reviewed.
plan: Add visible validation feedback on failed save (harms_trust, widespread) before any polish on layout.
human_follow_up: Enter an invalid email and press Save. What do you think happened?
